Since the crash seems graphics driver related I tried this on an Ubuntu 25.10 with an AMD graphics card and the crash did not occur.  Here additional driver information:

```

intree:         Y                                            
name:           nouveau                                      
retpoline:      Y                                          
vermagic:       6.17.0-6-generic SMP preempt mod_unload modversion
```

I did a couple straces as well, making sure to connect to the actual editor process and not the launcher.

[godot-strace3.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23184957/godot-strace3.txt)
[godot-strace4.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23184956/godot-strace4.txt)

I then switched to the proprietary nvidia driver and the issue stopped. At this point I am not sure if it is a nouveau issue or a godot issue.

It seems to be Mesa's Vulkan NVK driver crashing (Nouveau is the OpenGL one).

NVK is pretty new and might not be ready for production use, though I haven't tried it myself. We should aim to support it eventually as it seems more promising than Nouveau ever was for GL, as Nvidia is actually providing some docs to help NVK IIRC.

A workaround (which is maybe the difference you had on earlier Ubuntu versions) would be to use the proprietary Nvidia drivers instead of NVK.

Thanks, for me the issue is resolved by using proprietary drivers. I leave it up to you if you want to close this or keep it open since I don't know if it is a godot or mesa bug. 

Thank you for the help and the great project.

We are not in a position where every machine can use the proprietary drivers due to other stability concerns with more modern GPUs that have a much more stable OS experience, particularly when using Fedora as the base, with NVK.

This was not an issue with Godot 4.4.x or prior and only began to be an issue with Godot 4.5 and later.

Which Godot commit is the stacktrace for?

Can you file a bug report upstream with Mesa? I agree we should aim to support NVK but if it's the only driver crashing on this code, and it crashes in the driver's own library, it's a priori a Mesa NVK bug and not a Godot issue.
